title: 中央咖啡馆
summary: 维也纳第一区赫伦街 14 号的传统咖啡馆，1876 年开业，位于费斯特宫底层。它因 19 世纪末至 20 世纪初的知识分子聚会而闻名；今天首先是咖啡馆，茶单是配角。

title: Café Central
summary: A traditional Viennese coffee house at Herrengasse 14, opened in 1876 on the ground floor of Palais Ferstel. It is known for its late-nineteenth and early-twentieth-century intellectual circles, but it is a coffee house first and a tea stop second.

title: 萨赫咖啡馆
summary: 维也纳国家歌剧院对面的萨赫酒店内咖啡馆，以 Original Sacher-Torte 为核心。读它要把 1832 年的创制传说、1876 年的酒店史和 1963 年前后的蛋糕争议分开。

title: Café Sacher
summary: The café inside Hotel Sacher, opposite the Vienna State Opera, built around the Original Sacher-Torte. Read it in three layers: the 1832 creation story, the hotel history from 1876, and the cake dispute around 1963.

title: 帝后饭店下午茶
summary: 费尔蒙特帝后饭店位于维多利亚内港畔，1908 年由加拿大太平洋铁路公司开设，是加拿大国家历史遗址。酒店的下午茶以“Tea at the Empress”名义经营，属于酒店内的英式下午茶传统，而非独立的街边茶馆。

title: Fairmont Empress Afternoon Tea (Victoria)
summary: The Fairmont Empress sits on Victoria's Inner Harbour. Opened by the Canadian Pacific Railway in 1908, it is a National Historic Site with 431 rooms, and its afternoon tea is a hotel experience rather than a standalone teahouse.

title: 老舍茶馆
summary: 老舍茶馆位于北京前门西大街正阳市场，1988 年开业，以作家老舍命名，集茶饮、京味小吃和曲艺、京剧等演出于一体。它是当代北京的代表性文化茶馆，不是老舍笔下的历史茶馆原址。

title: Lao She Teahouse
summary: Lao She Teahouse is on Qianmen West Street in Beijing, opened in 1988 and named after the writer Lao She. It combines tea, Beijing snacks and stage performances such as quyi, Peking opera and acrobatics; it is a modern cultural teahouse, not the original site of Lao She’s fictional teahouse.

title: 陶陶居
summary: 陶陶居 1880 年在广州西关第十甫路开业，是粤式茶楼“一盅两件”的代表之一。它经历 1925 年扩建、20 世纪末出租、2018 年收回与 2022 年重开，现由广州酒家集团经营，地址仍在第十甫路。

title: Tao Tao Ju (Guangzhou)
summary: Tao Tao Ju opened on Dishifu Road in Guangzhou's Xiguan district in 1880 and became a representative Cantonese tea house of the "one cup, two pieces" tradition. After a 1925 expansion, a late-twentieth-century lease, a 2018 recovery and a 2022 reopening, it is now operated by the Guangzhou Restaurant Group at its original Dishifu Road address.

title: 香港莲香楼
summary: 香港莲香楼源于 1889 年广州莲香楼，1927 年在中环开店，1996 年迁至威灵顿街。它 2022 年 8 月关闭，2024 年 4 月重开，2026 年 5 月迁往上环德辅道中 249—253 号，继续以手推点心车、盖碗茶和“一盅两件”经营。

title: Lin Heung Tea House (Hong Kong)
summary: Hong Kong's Lin Heung Tea House traces its brand to the Guangzhou Lin Heung of 1889 and opened in Central in 1927. It moved to Wellington Street in 1996, closed in August 2022, reopened in April 2024 and moved to 249–253 Des Voeux Road Central in Sheung Wan in May 2026, keeping its trolley dim sum, covered-bowl tea and "one cup, two pieces" service.

title: 陆羽茶室
summary: 香港中环的老式粤式茶楼，1933年创办，1976年迁至士丹利街；以酸枝家具、字画、旧招牌与点心和茶市闻名。
location: 中国 · 香港特别行政区

title: Luk Yu Teahouse
summary: A long-running Cantonese tea house in Central, Hong Kong, founded in 1933 and moved to Stanley Street in 1976; read it through rosewood furniture, calligraphy, old signage and the rhythm of tea and dim sum.

title: 湖心亭茶楼
summary: 湖心亭茶楼位于上海豫园九曲桥荷花池中央，是上海现存最古老的茶楼之一。建筑可追溯至 1784 年，1855 年起开设茶楼；经过 2023–2025 年保护性修缮，于 2025 年 7 月重新向公众开放。

title: Huxinting Teahouse
summary: Huxinting Teahouse sits in the middle of the lotus pond at Yu Garden’s Nine-Bend Bridge in Shanghai, one of the city’s oldest teahouses. The building dates to 1784 and became a teahouse in 1855; after restoration from 2023 to 2025, it reopened to the public on 10 July 2025.

title: 观音阁老茶馆
summary: 成都双流彭镇马市坝街的百年老茶馆，前身为清代观音阁；老虎灶、千脚泥地面、竹椅与盖碗茶仍在日常使用，2024年获联合国教科文组织亚太文化遗产保护奖优秀奖。

title: Guanyinge Old Teahouse, Peng Town
summary: A century-old tea house on Mashi Ba Street in Peng Town, Shuangliu, Chengdu, housed in a former Qing Guanyin shrine; its tiger stove, trodden-earth floor, bamboo chairs and gaiwan tea remain in daily use, and its restoration won a 2024 UNESCO Asia-Pacific heritage award.

title: 鹤鸣茶社
summary: 成都人民公园内的百年茶社，1923年创办，以竹椅、矮桌、盖碗茶、长嘴铜壶与公园里的日常茶生活闻名。

title: Heming Teahouse
summary: A century-old tea house in Chengdu’s People’s Park, founded in 1923 and known for bamboo chairs, low tables, gaiwan tea, long-spout copper kettles and the slow everyday life of a public park.

title: 紫藤庐
summary: 台北新生南路三段巷内的日式老屋茶空间，1981年改为茶艺馆，1997年指定为台北市定古迹；自2024年12月起闭馆整修。

title: Wistaria Tea House
summary: A Japanese-era wooden house in Taipei, converted into a tea house in 1981 and designated a city historical site in 1997; closed since December 2024 for a multi-year restoration.

title: 喀什百年老茶馆
summary: 喀什老城吾斯塘博依路与库木代尔瓦扎路交会处的百年茶馆，以茯砖茶、清茶、药茶、馕、土炕与木卡姆弹唱构成日常空间。
location: 中国 · 新疆维吾尔自治区

title: Kashgar Old Tea House
summary: A century-old tea house at the junction of Wusitangboyi and Kumudai’erwaza roads in Kashgar’s old town, where fu brick tea, clear tea, medicinal infusions, naan, earthen platforms and muqam music share one room.

title: 布拉格斯拉维亚咖啡馆
summary: 斯拉维亚咖啡馆在布拉格 Národní 街 8 号、正对国家剧院。它 1881 年在此开设，1884 年以 Slavia 重开，1931–32 年改为装饰艺术风格；它是捷克文学与异议政治的会面场所，不是专门茶馆。

title: Café Slavia, Prague
titleAlt: 布拉格斯拉维亚咖啡馆
summary: Café Slavia stands at Národní 8 in Prague, facing the National Theatre. A café opened on the site in 1881, it reopened as Slavia in 1884 and was remodelled in Art Deco style in 1931–32; it is a Czech literary and dissident meeting place rather than a specialised teahouse.

title: 费沙维咖啡馆
summary: 开罗汗·哈利利市场里的老咖啡馆，以镜子、薄荷茶与文学记忆闻名；读它时要区分创业年代的口述、家族记忆与可核验的记载。

title: El Fishawy Café
summary: An old café in Cairo’s Khan el-Khalili market, known for mirrors, mint tea and literary memory; read its founding date and famous visitors as layered claims, not a single verified story.

title: 安吉丽娜（巴黎里沃利街）
summary: 安吉丽娜 1903 年在巴黎里沃利街开业，是 Belle Époque 风格的沙龙式茶室与糕点店。它的招牌是浓稠的热巧克力 L’Africain 与栗子奶油蒙布朗；空间由 Niermans 设计，茶、咖啡与甜点在同一张菜单上。

title: Angelina, Rue de Rivoli, Paris
titleAlt: 安吉丽娜（巴黎里沃利街）
summary: Angelina opened on Rue de Rivoli in 1903 as a Belle Époque salon de thé and pâtisserie. Its signatures are the thick L’Africain hot chocolate and the chestnut Mont-Blanc; the Niermans-designed room serves tea, coffee and pastries on one menu.

title: 拉杜丽茶室
summary: 巴黎皇家街 16 号的甜点与茶室品牌，1862 年由 Louis Ernest Ladurée 创立。它的核心不是茶叶专门店，而是法式甜点、马卡龙与沙龙式饮茶。

title: Ladurée
summary: A Paris pastry and tea-room house at 16 Rue Royale, founded in 1862 by Louis Ernest Ladurée. Its core is French pastry, macarons and salon-style tea, not specialist tea retail.

title: 玛黑兄弟茶
summary: 巴黎玛黑区的法国茶叶进口商与茶室，1854年创立，1984年转向零售；读它要把品牌叙事、批发史与今天的茶单分开。

title: Mariage Frères
summary: A Paris tea importer and tea house founded in 1854, which only opened to retail in 1984; read the brand story, the wholesale history and today’s tea menu as separate layers.

title: 纽约咖啡馆（布达佩斯）
summary: 纽约咖啡馆 1894 年在布达佩斯纽约宫底层开业，是匈牙利文学与咖啡屋文化的核心空间。它首先是一间咖啡屋，不是专门茶馆；大理石柱、壁画、吊灯和现场音乐共同构成它的体验，2006 年按历史资料修复。

title: New York Café, Budapest
summary: New York Café opened in 1894 on the ground floor of Budapest’s New York Palace and became a centre of Hungarian literary coffee-house culture. It is a coffee house rather than a specialised teahouse; marble columns, frescoes, chandeliers and live music define the room, restored in 2006.

title: 雅加达巴达维亚咖啡馆
summary: 巴达维亚咖啡馆在雅加达老城一座 19 世纪初的荷印建筑内，1993 年由 Graham James 修复后开业。它以荷印与印尼混合菜、二层 Grand Salon 和正对 Fatahillah 广场的百叶窗为特色，不是传统茶馆。

title: Café Batavia, Jakarta
titleAlt: 雅加达巴达维亚咖啡馆
summary: Café Batavia occupies an early nineteenth-century Dutch colonial building in Jakarta’s old town and opened in 1993 after a restoration by Graham James. It is known for Dutch-Indonesian cooking, the first-floor Grand Salon and shutters facing Fatahillah Square, not for a traditional tea service.

title: 一保堂茶舗
summary: 一保堂茶舗创立于 1717 年，是京都寺町通二条的老字号日本茶铺，销售抹茶、玉露、煎茶等，并设有茶室“嘉木”供客人品饮。它是茶铺与茶室结合的经营场所，不是传统意义上的餐馆。

title: Ippodo Tea
summary: Ippodo Tea was founded in 1717 and is a long-established Japanese tea shop on Teramachi-dori in Kyoto. It sells matcha, gyokuro and sencha and has a tea room, Kiki, for tasting. It is a tea shop with a tea room, not a full-service restaurant.

title: La Mamounia 的茶室
titleAlt: The tea rooms at La Mamounia
summary: 马拉喀什 La Mamounia 酒店的两处茶室，放在一座由18世纪花园、铁路时代酒店与摩洛哥工艺共同构成的空间里阅读。

title: The tea rooms at La Mamounia
summary: Two tea rooms inside a Marrakech palace hotel, read through an eighteenth- century garden, a railway-era building, and the meeting of Moroccan craft and Art Deco.

title: 佩尔洛夫茶屋
summary: 莫斯科 Myasnitskaya 街 19 号的佩尔洛夫茶屋，1890—1893 年由 Roman Klein 建成，1895—1896 年改为中国风立面。它曾是俄罗斯帝国重要的茶叶贸易商号，1917 年后国有化，1998 年启动、历时约 12 年的修复后，于 2012 年重新营业。

title: Perlov Tea House (Moscow)
summary: The Perlov Tea House at 19 Myasnitskaya Street, Moscow, was built by Roman Klein in 1890–1893 and refaced in a Chinese style in 1895–1896. Once a major imperial tea merchant house, it was nationalised after 1917 and, after a restoration begun in 1998 and lasting about twelve years, reopened in 2012 as a tea and coffee shop.

title: 莱佛士酒店 Tiffin Room
titleAlt: Tiffin Room at Raffles Hotel Singapore
summary: Tiffin Room 在新加坡莱佛士酒店内，商号可追溯到 1892 年，1910 年迁入酒店，1976 年定名。它是一间北印度餐室，以 tandoor、铜制 tiffin 盒和桌边研磨香料为特色，不是独立茶沙龙。

title: Tiffin Room at Raffles Hotel Singapore
summary: Tiffin Room sits inside Raffles Hotel Singapore, with a business history going back to 1892, a move into the hotel in 1910 and its present name from 1976. It is a North Indian dining room known for tandoor cooking, copper tiffin boxes and tableside spice grinding, not a standalone tea salon.

title: 山龙内尔酒店下午茶
summary: 开普敦山龙内尔酒店 1899 年开业，位于桌山脚下的 Gardens 街区。酒店把下午茶安排在 Lounge 与 Windsor Table，供应 60 多种散叶茶和三层点心；这是一项 1989 年 11 月引入的酒店餐饮传统，不是独立茶馆。

title: Mount Nelson Afternoon Tea (Cape Town)
summary: The Mount Nelson Hotel opened in Cape Town in 1899, at the foot of Table Mountain in the Gardens district. Its afternoon tea is served in the Lounge and the Windsor Table with more than 60 loose-leaf teas and a three-tier stand; it was introduced in November 1989 as a hotel dining tradition, not as an independent teahouse.

title: 马德里希洪咖啡馆
summary: 希洪咖啡馆 1888 年在马德里 Recoletos 开业，是西班牙 tertulia 文学聚会的代表空间。1949 年在此创立 Café Gijón 小说奖；2025 年底出售、2026 年 4 月以 Capucchino Grand Café Gijón 重开，地址与旧空间保留。

title: Café Gijón, Madrid
summary: Café Gijón opened on Madrid’s Paseo de Recoletos in 1888 and became a symbol of Spanish literary tertulias. The Café Gijón novel prize was founded there in 1949; after a sale in late 2025 it reopened in April 2026 as Capucchino Grand Café Gijón, keeping the address and historic room.

title: 贝蒂斯茶室（约克）
summary: 贝蒂斯约克店在圣海伦广场，1937 年开业。它把瑞士糖果师的烘焙传统、约克郡茶的供应链和玛丽皇后号邮轮式内饰放在同一间茶室里；既可日常吃茶点，也可在贝尔蒙特厅预订一套下午茶。

title: Bettys Café Tea Rooms, York
summary: Bettys York opened on St Helen’s Square in 1937. It combines a Swiss confectioner’s baking tradition, Yorkshire tea and Queen Mary-inspired interiors in one café tea room, with everyday counter service and bookable afternoon tea in the Belmont Room.

title: 福南梅森钻石禧年茶沙龙
titleAlt: Fortnum & Mason Diamond Jubilee Tea Salon (London)
summary: 福南梅森 1707 年创立，181 Piccadilly 旗舰店四楼的 Diamond Jubilee Tea Salon 于 2012 年 3 月由伊丽莎白二世揭幕。它把百货公司的茶叶零售、正式茶席与钢琴伴奏放在同一层楼，是伦敦少见的“百货内茶沙龙”。

title: Fortnum & Mason Diamond Jubilee Tea Salon (London)
titleAlt: 福南梅森钻石禧年茶沙龙
summary: Fortnum & Mason was founded in 1707, and its Diamond Jubilee Tea Salon on the fourth floor of the Piccadilly flagship was opened by Elizabeth II in March 2012. The salon combines the department store's tea retail, a formal tea service and live piano in one floor, making it an unusual "tea salon within a department store".

title: 水泵房茶厅
summary: 巴斯水泵房是 18 世纪末建成的乔治式社交建筑，今天由 Searcys 经营为餐厅与茶厅。它把矿泉水泉眼、科林斯柱式大厅和英式下午茶放在同一空间里，和普通街边茶馆不是一类场所。

title: The Pump Room (Bath)
summary: Bath's Pump Room is a late-eighteenth-century Georgian social building, now run by Searcys as a restaurant and tea room. It combines a mineral spring, a Corinthian-columned hall and English afternoon tea in one room, which makes it different from an ordinary street teahouse.

title: 伦敦丽思酒店下午茶
titleAlt: Afternoon Tea at The Ritz London
summary: 伦敦丽思酒店 1906 年在皮卡迪利开业，下午茶在棕榈庭供应。它把路易十六风格的空间、三层点心、约 20 种散叶茶和正式着装要求放在同一套体验里，是酒店餐饮而不是独立茶馆。

title: Afternoon Tea at The Ritz London
summary: The Ritz London opened at 150 Piccadilly in 1906 and serves afternoon tea in the Palm Court. Its Louis XVI-style room, three-tier stand, roughly 20 loose-leaf teas and formal dress code make it a hotel ritual rather than a standalone teahouse.

title: 川宁茶店
summary: 伦敦斯特兰德街 216 号的川宁老店，1706 年由 Thomas Twining 开设，仍在同一地址经营。它是茶叶零售店与品牌旗舰店，不是传统英式下午茶沙龙。

title: Twinings Tea Shop (216 Strand)
summary: The Twinings shop at 216 Strand in London, opened by Thomas Twining in 1706 and still trading at the same address. It is a tea retailer and brand flagship, not a traditional English afternoon-tea salon.

title: 麦金托什茶室（柳树茶室）
summary: 格拉斯哥 Sauchiehall 街 217 号的茶室由 Catherine Cranston 于 1903 年开设，Charles Rennie Mackintosh 与 Margaret Macdonald 参与设计。它 2018 年修复重开，2024 年由国家信托苏格兰接管，2026 年更名为 The Mackintosh Tearooms。

title: The Mackintosh Tearooms (Willow Tea Rooms)
titleAlt: 麦金托什茶室（柳树茶室）
summary: The tea rooms at 217 Sauchiehall Street, Glasgow, were opened by Catherine Cranston in 1903, with interiors by Charles Rennie Mackintosh and Margaret Macdonald. Restored and reopened in 2018, taken over by the National Trust for Scotland in 2024 and renamed The Mackintosh Tearooms in 2026.
